verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration is a government immigration authority and citizen-facing visa application service, not a developer or API platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any developer API or credential system that would make the axis apply; its online tools (eVisas, the ID Check app, processing-time checks) are interactive services for applicants.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
